reasoning-01-identity.referenceProof: by intro p h; exact h

reasoning-02-and_left.referenceProof: by intro p q h; exact h.left

reasoning-03-zero_add.referenceProof: by intro n; exact Nat.zero_add n

reasoning-04-and_swap.referenceProof: by intro p q h; exact ⟨h.right, h.left⟩

reasoning-05-or_swap.referenceProof: by intro p q h; cases h with | inl hp => exact Or.inr hp | inr hq => exact Or.inl hq

reasoning-06-compose.referenceProof: by intro p q r hpq hqr hp; exact hqr (hpq hp)

reasoning-07-explosion.referenceProof: by intro p q hn hp; exact False.elim (hn hp)

reasoning-08-add_comm.referenceProof: by intro n m; exact Nat.add_comm n m

reasoning-09-mul_one.referenceProof: by intro n; exact Nat.mul_one n

reasoning-10-le_refl.referenceProof: by intro n; exact Nat.le_refl n

reasoning-11-zero_le.referenceProof: by intro n; exact Nat.zero_le n
